target: EPCR Taipei Socket.IO WebSocket authentication barrier

tests.name: Handshake (polling)
tests.detail: HTTP 200, sid issued (e.g., O4-bvithgXmBko3), no auth required

tests.name: CONNECT (polling POST, body=2:40)
tests.detail: HTTP 200, body='ok' — server accepts Socket.IO CONNECT

tests.name: Server-initiated CONNECT in handshake
tests.detail: Handshake response contains '2:40' = Engine.IO MESSAGE(4) + Socket.IO CONNECT(0). Server sends CONNECT to client during handshake.

tests.name: Long-polling receive
tests.detail: First poll times out (expected). Second poll returns 400 'Session ID unknown' — session invalidated after handshake.
tests.session_cookie: io=<sid> (cookie maintained but session still invalidated)

tests.name: WebSocket upgrade
tests.detail: TCP + HTTP 101 established. WebSocketApp with proxy_type=socks5. on_open fires.

tests.name: WebSocket CONNECT (40, no JWT)
tests.detail: Server sends close frame (fin=1, opcode=8, data=b'') — empty close, no status code, immediate termination

tests.name: WebSocket CONNECT with JWT (test/dummy/jwt-format)
tests.detail: All 3 JWT variants rejected — server closes immediately (same empty close frame)

tests.name: WebSocket CONNECT with browser headers (UA+Origin+Referer)
tests.detail: Same — server closes regardless of headers

tests.name: POST /case/push?token=...
tests.detail: Body: 'jwt malformed' -- endpoint exists, requires valid JWT token

tests.name: JWT forge + CONNECT (v3)
tests.detail: JWT forged with leaked secret. 3 CONNECT formats accepted: token/auth_token/bearer. All HTTP 200 ok

tests.name: Long-poll with forged JWT
tests.detail: CONNECT: HTTP 200 ok. First poll: timeout 25s (server holds connection waiting for events). Second poll: HTTP 400 Session ID unknown

tests.name: HTTP API /DispatchRecords POST with forged JWT
tests.detail: HTTP 400 'notNull Violation: ambulanceCode cannot be null' -- endpoint accepts forged JWT

analysis: The handshake response includes a server-initiated CONNECT (2:40), suggesting the EPCR Socket.IO server uses non-standard protocol flow. The server accepts polling CONNECT but invalidates the session for subsequent polling. WebSocket connections are always closed (possibly server-side WebSocket handler disabled or JWT-required). The /case/push endpoint is real but requires valid JWT.
